descriptionChirho: Gentilic noun referring to a member or members of the Canaanite people group, the pre-Israelite inhabitants of the land of Canaan, in all grammatical forms including masculine, feminine, singular, plural, and with various prepositions and conjunctions.
Metaphorical extension of the gentilic meaning 'Canaanite' to denote a merchant or trader, reflecting the Canaanites' well-known association with commerce and trade in the ancient Near East.
